answer_1.quote: We propose a video question answering dataset called CRIPP-VQA... The task is to predict which collisions may or may not happen if we perform the action on an object.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to descriptive, counterfactual, and planning questions

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the models, we use two accuracy metrics -per-option (PO) and per-question (PQ) accuracy... We use TDW to re-simulate the models' predictions... leading to iterative performance evaluation.
